meta.title: Just in Case Car Kit
meta.notes: Prices are approximate and pre-tax. Existing lean/complete prices were spot-checked from product pages fetched on November 25, 2026, Eastern Time, except items whose pages could not be opened. Bottled water was added to the lean and complete totals from a fetched Walmart page ($3.97). Unverified items say 'check current price' and are omitted from totals. affiliate_url is left blank until Robie is approved for Walmart Affiliates (Impact) and pastes tracking links here.

items.name: Performance Tool W1498 DOT Warning Triangle, 3-pack
items.why: If your car is stopped, other drivers need to see you in time. Official lists call for flares or a reflective triangle. Reusable DOT-style triangles avoid storing burning flares in a hot trunk.
items.shipping_note: This lookup also showed $6.99 shipping unless the order meets a free-shipping threshold.

items.name: Orion Safety Products DOT-compliant triangles, 3-pack, model 461
items.why: A well-known DOT-compliant set if you want a heavier, more established brand than the budget pack.
items.shipping_note: Free shipping in the Nov 24 lookup.

items.name: Energizer LED Rechargeable Flashlight, 350 lumens, with USB cable
items.why: You may need light to change a tire, read a gauge, or signal. Keep it where you can reach it without emptying the trunk.

items.name: Energizer Tac-R 3000-lumen compact tactical LED flashlight, USB-C rechargeable
items.why: A brighter, sturdier light if you often drive at night or want more reserve brightness.

items.name: Greatway / Kobalt 12-ft, 4-gauge jumper cables
items.why: Dead batteries are a common roadside problem, especially in the cold. Cables work when a second vehicle can help.
items.shipping_note: Free shipping in the Nov 24 lookup.

items.name: NOCO Boost GB40, 1000A lithium jump starter
items.why: Works when no second vehicle is available, which matters on a quiet road at night. Rated for gasoline engines up to 6.0L and diesel up to 3.0L. Recharge it every few months.

items.name: Energizer 10,000mAh 22.5W 4-port power bank with built-in USB-C cables
items.why: A car charger does not help if the vehicle battery is dead. Keep a charged power bank in the cabin, not in a freezing or baking trunk.

items.name: Midland ER10VP compact emergency weather-alert radio
items.why: A NOAA weather radio receives alerts but generally cannot transmit a distress signal. A whistle or light may help signal nearby rescuers.
items.shipping_note: The Nov 24 product description also said the ER10 might be temporarily out of stock. Confirm stock before you buy.

items.name: Midland ER310 E+Ready emergency crank weather radio
items.why: A crank and solar model with a light, if you want a radio that does not depend only on a stored charge.
items.shipping_note: This lookup showed $9.99 shipping. Prefer Midland or a major retailer if they have it in stock.

items.name: Safety Works yellow high-visibility reflective vest, ANSI/ISEA Type R Class 2
items.why: You need to be seen if you step out of the car at night, in fog, or on a shoulder.

items.name: YeewayVeh 35-inch 2-in-1 snow brush and ice scraper
items.why: The everyday winter tool. Official lists all include an ice scraper.

items.name: JOYTUTUS 41.5-inch extendable snow brush and ice scraper
items.why: A longer, extendable brush is easier on a taller vehicle or a wider windshield.

items.name: Suncast 11-inch telescoping car snow shovel
items.why: You need to dig snow, slush, or mud away from the tires. It does not have to clear a driveway.
items.shipping_note: This lookup also showed $5.99 shipping unless the order meets a free-shipping threshold.

items.name: Michelin Ultra Compact telescoping utility snow shovel
items.why: A sturdier compact shovel if you often park where snow piles against the tires.
items.shipping_note: Free shipping in the Nov 24 lookup.

items.name: Emergency thermal rain poncho, hooded
items.why: You may have to change a tire or set out triangles in the rain or sleet.
items.shipping_note: Marketplace seller in this lookup; confirm the seller if you order online.

items.name: toolant winter leather work gloves with 3M Thinsulate lining
items.why: Bare hands on a frozen scraper, shovel, or lug wrench go numb quickly. Confirm size before you buy.

items.name: Ozark Trail reusable emergency survival blanket
items.why: Mylar blankets pack small and help hold body heat if you are waiting in a cold vehicle.

items.name: Molithe 100% wool blanket, 62 x 86 in.
items.why: A real wool blanket is more comfortable than mylar if you may be waiting for hours.

items.name: First Aid Only / American Red Cross Auto First Aid Kit (about 40–42 pieces)
items.why: Every official list includes a first-aid kit for cuts, scrapes, and basic care. This is not medical advice. Add your own medicines and check expiration dates twice a year.
items.shipping_note: The official Red Cross store listed the same kit at $12.50 but with $27.80 shipping in the Nov 24 lookup, so this page uses Rescue Supply.

items.name: American Red Cross Emergency Preparedness Auto Kit with first aid (soft case)
items.why: A larger auto kit if you want more supplies in one soft case.
items.shipping_note: This lookup also showed $11.69 shipping.

items.name: Brookstone Automotive Tire Inflator Mini Air Compressor, 12V, 300 PSI
items.why: A 12-volt inflator can add enough air to a low tire to reach a shop, and many include a gauge. Check the door-jamb pressure, not the number on the tire sidewall.
items.shipping_note: Sold by Walmart in the Nov 25 lookup. Replaced the earlier Amazon Basics inflator ($27.97) so the lean kit can use a verified Walmart page.

items.name: AstroAI L2 cordless tire inflator, 6600 mAh battery and 12V cord
items.why: A cordless inflator still works if you cannot run the car or reach a 12-volt outlet easily.
items.shipping_note: Sold by Walmart in the Nov 25 lookup.

items.name: Fix-A-Flat 16-oz aerosol tire sealant, S60420
items.why: A get-to-the-shop fix for some small punctures when you cannot safely change the tire. Check whether your tires and sensors allow sealant, and have the tire inspected afterward.

items.name: First Alert AUTO5 car fire extinguisher, UL 5-B:C
items.why: An appropriately rated UL 5-B:C unit suitable for vehicle storage, with a vehicle mount included. Secure it using an appropriate mounting bracket. In a vehicle fire, evacuate, move away and call 911; prioritize personal safety.
items.shipping_note: Marketplace seller in this lookup; buying the same model in a store is often simpler.

items.name: The Original Duck Tape, 1.88 in. x 55 yd., silver
items.why: For temporary, non-critical repairs, such as securing loose interior trim.

items.name: Great Value Purified Drinking Water, 16.9 fl oz, 24 Count
items.why: Essential. A 24-count case is an economical way to buy; pack several bottles in the vehicle and rotate them. You do not need all 24 in the trunk. Move bottles into the cabin in a hard freeze. Sold by Walmart. Price from the product page fetched November 25, 2026, Eastern Time.

items.name: Non-perishable snacks (granola bars or similar)
items.why: Essential in all three builds. A single-box snack price was not verified from a fetched product page, so this stays 'check current price' and is not in the lean or complete totals.

items.name: Swiss Tech Helfen 12-in-1 multi-tool knife
items.why: A compact tool for cutting, tightening, and small repairs without packing a full toolbox.
items.shipping_note: Sold by Walmart in the Nov 25 lookup. Replaced the earlier PERWIN tool ($20.18, Amazon) to prefer a verified Walmart page.

items.name: Gerber Truss 17-in-1 multi-tool
items.why: A sturdier, better-known multi-tool if you want to upgrade that one piece.

items.name: VEVOR heavy-duty tow strap recovery kit, 3 in. x 30 ft, with sleeves, shackles, and bag
items.why: Useful only if you know how to use it and stay within the ratings. It is easy to use unsafely. Skip this piece if you are not comfortable with vehicle recovery.

items.name: Ready America 2-person 3-day emergency food and water kit
items.why: If you may be stranded, you need water and food that can sit in the car. The listing describes six 1-liter water cartons and three 2,400-calorie bars, with a 10-year shelf life. In a hard freeze, move water into the cabin so bottles do not split. A cheaper path is grocery-store water and snacks, rotated often.

items.name: Waterproof travel document pouch
items.why: Keep copies of insurance, registration, and emergency contacts in the car — not original Social Security cards or the only copy of important papers. This is the natural link to the Just in Case organizer, where the fuller records live.

items.name: Rand McNally 2027 Large Scale Road Atlas
items.why: A printed map still works when GPS and cell service fail. A printed state or local map is a cheaper budget path.

items.name: Warning triangles, 3-pack (look for DOT-rated)
items.why: Official lists call for warning triangles or flares so other drivers can see a stopped vehicle in time. Look for a 3-pack that is actually DOT-rated — many bargain sets are not. Harbor Freight did not appear to sell a DOT triangle set when this list was checked.
items.retailer: Temu or a local auto-parts aisle
items.source_note: No reliable current Temu price was verified; Temu prices swing. Do not invent a number.

items.name: WESTERN SAFETY collapsible reflective emergency cone
items.why: A weaker substitute for a 3-pack of DOT-rated warning triangles. This is one 15-1/2 inch cone, not a triangle set, and it is light. Useful on a quiet street or shoulder; it is not a highway-grade warning triangle. Upgrade to a DOT 3-pack when you can.
items.shipping_note: Approximate pre-tax price from a Harbor Freight product page fetched on November 25, 2026, Eastern Time. Prices will change.
items.source_note: Fetched https://www.harborfreight.com/collapsible-reflective-emergency-cone-94111.html on 2026-11-25 ET; page price $12.99.

items.name: BRAUN 800 lumen tactical LED flashlight
items.why: You may need light to change a tire, read a gauge, or signal. This model includes batteries. Keep it where you can reach it without emptying the trunk.
items.shipping_note: Approximate pre-tax price from a Harbor Freight product page fetched on November 25, 2026, Eastern Time. Prices will change.
items.source_note: Fetched https://www.harborfreight.com/800-lumen-tactical-led-flashlight-70765.html on 2026-11-25 ET; page price $11.99.

items.name: PITTSBURGH 12 ft., 10-gauge jumper cables
items.why: A cheaper, thinner set than the 4-gauge cables in the lean kit. These are copper-coated aluminum, rated 150 amps, and they need a second car. They may struggle in deep cold or on a larger engine. For a first kit, cables like these are a safer choice than a bargain lithium jump starter.
items.shipping_note: Approximate pre-tax price from a Harbor Freight product page fetched on November 25, 2026, Eastern Time. Prices will change.
items.source_note: Fetched https://www.harborfreight.com/12-ft-10-gauge-jumper-cables-63376.html on 2026-11-25 ET; page price $9.99.

items.name: Phone power bank
items.why: Follow manufacturer storage and charging temperature limits. Remove it from a parked vehicle when temperatures may exceed those limits, and secure it during travel.
items.source_note: Temu search did not yield a trustworthy simple power-bank match; do not invent a price.

items.name: 12-volt USB car charger and a spare cable
items.why: Still useful when the car will start. A simple charger from a grocery, dollar, or electronics aisle is enough.
items.source_note: Not verified on a specific product page.

items.name: BE SMART GET PREPARED 10-person, 101-piece first-aid kit
items.why: This is a workplace-style kit, not an auto-specific kit. Cheap kits vary in quality and completeness. Check dates, add your own medicines, and know that the kit’s ANSI claim applies only when the required minimum fill is maintained.
items.shipping_note: Approximate pre-tax price from a Harbor Freight product page fetched on November 25, 2026, Eastern Time. Prices will change.
items.source_note: Fetched https://www.harborfreight.com/10-person-first-aid-kit-101-piece-70908.html on 2026-11-25 ET; page price $19.99 (an earlier category listing had shown $17.99; the product page is the source used here).

items.name: WESTERN SAFETY yellow reflective safety vest, Large
items.why: So you can be seen if you step onto a shoulder. The Harbor Freight listing says the reflective strips meet or exceed ANSI safety standards and the vest is ANSI compliant. Confirm the size before you buy.
items.shipping_note: Approximate pre-tax price from a Harbor Freight product page fetched on November 25, 2026, Eastern Time. Prices will change.
items.source_note: Fetched https://www.harborfreight.com/reflective-safety-vest-large-94701.html on 2026-11-25 ET; page price $7.99.

items.name: Ice scraper and snow brush
items.why: The everyday winter tool on official lists. Harbor Freight did not show a dedicated car ice scraper when this list was checked. Look on Temu or in a grocery or auto-parts aisle.
items.retailer: Temu or a grocery / auto-parts aisle
items.source_note: No reliable current Temu price was used; listings were messy and prices swing.

items.name: BADLAND foldable utility shovel
items.why: A compact folding utility shovel with a plastic handle. Fine for light snow, slush, or mud around the tires, but it is not a full-size snow shovel.
items.shipping_note: Approximate pre-tax price from a Harbor Freight product page fetched on November 25, 2026, Eastern Time. Prices will change.
items.source_note: Fetched https://www.harborfreight.com/foldable-utility-shovel-57703.html on 2026-11-25 ET; page price $14.99.

items.name: Non-clumping cat litter or sand
items.why: Official winter lists recommend sand, salt, or non-clumping cat litter for tire traction. Buy a small bag locally. Avoid clumping litter.
items.source_note: Buy locally; no product page price.

items.name: Rain poncho
items.why: For changing a tire or setting out a cone or triangles in rain or sleet.
items.source_note: No reliable current Temu price was verified.

items.name: HARDY ANSI A5 cut-resistant work gloves, Large
items.why: Better than bare hands for a tire change or a shovel. These are work gloves, not insulated winter gloves — add a warm pair for a freeze.
items.shipping_note: Approximate pre-tax price from a Harbor Freight product page fetched on November 25, 2026, Eastern Time. Prices will change.
items.source_note: Fetched https://www.harborfreight.com/collections/automotive-tools/a5-cut-resistant-work-gloves-large-57643.html on 2026-11-25 ET; page price $5.99.

items.name: FRANKLIN 40 in. x 50 in. moving blanket
items.why: A cheap warmth or ground layer for the trunk. Harbor Freight says this moving blanket is not intended for use as bedding. It is not a purpose-made emergency blanket, so also pack a mylar blanket if you can.
items.shipping_note: Approximate pre-tax price from a Harbor Freight product page fetched on November 25, 2026, Eastern Time. Prices will change.
items.source_note: Fetched https://www.harborfreight.com/40-in-x-50-in-moving-blanket-58328.html on 2026-11-25 ET; page price $3.79.

items.name: Emergency Mylar blanket
items.why: Packs small and helps hold body heat. A Mylar blanket is a purpose-made emergency blanket.
items.source_note: No reliable current Temu price was verified.

items.name: PITTSBURGH 12V portable tire inflator with LED light
items.why: A budget 12-volt inflator for a low tire, so you can reach a shop. It plugs into the vehicle’s 12-volt port, so it will not help if the car battery is dead. Use the pressure on the door jamb. A member sale was listed on a category page the same day; the product page price used here is $16.99.

items.name: Whistle
items.why: Ready.gov lists a whistle to signal for help. A simple pea-less whistle is enough.
items.source_note: Not verified on a specific product page.

items.name: Drinking water
items.why: Essential in all three builds. Pack several bottles and rotate them. Move them into the cabin in a hard freeze, and do not leave them to overheat.
items.source_note: Buy locally; no product page price.

items.name: Non-perishable snacks
items.why: Essential in all three builds. Granola bars or other shelf-stable food. Check dates on your refresh schedule.
items.source_note: Buy locally; no product page price.

unverified_local.why: Official winter lists recommend sand, salt, or non-clumping cat litter for tire traction. Buy a small bag locally. Clumping litter can turn to mush when wet.
Air-activated warmers are a common winter add-on. They expire, so check the date.

unverified_local.short_name: 12-volt USB car charger and a spare cable
unverified_local.why: Still useful when the car will start. A simple name-brand charger is enough. Price was not verified on a specific product page for this draft.
Ready.gov lists a whistle to signal for help. A simple pea-less whistle from a sporting-goods aisle is enough.

unverified_local.short_name: Wet wipes, trash bags, and a roll of toilet paper
